- Integrates Apify for content and competitor scraping, Claude AI for writing, and InVideo AI for promo videos.
- Identifies sponsorship, affiliate, and product monetization opportunities tailored to your audience.
- Delivers a full weekly plan with newsletter copy, subject lines, growth hooks, monetization placements, and ready-to-share video teasers.
